asideNextText: Need numbers for a lottery ticket instead? The Lottery Number Generator has the official Powerball and Mega Millions formats built in.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling and unbiased shuffling — the same quality of randomness used by security software, not the predictable Math.random().
Yes — set decimal places above zero and each number is generated at that precision inside your range.
With unique on, no value repeats within a batch (as long as the range has enough possible values — the tool tells you if you ask for more than exist).

heroSubtitle: Truly random numbers from your browser's cryptographic RNG — no patterns, no predictability.
metaDescription: Generate random numbers in any range with a cryptographically secure generator. Set min, max, quantity, decimals and uniqueness — free, no sign-up.
title: Random Number Generator — Free & Secure Online Tool | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Random is not the same as suitable — lottery draws, audits, and legal selections have official processes; use this for everyday decisions, games, and testing.
For cryptographic keys or tokens, use a dedicated key generator in your password manager or OS, not a web page.
